catalysts.headline: Positive Phase 3 Panorama topline for DT120 ODT in generalized anxiety disorder: 100µg dose showed 5.1-point placebo-adjusted HAM-A improvement at Week 12 (p<0.0001, Cohen's d=0.64; LS mean change -9.8 vs -4.7 placebo); efficacy observed by Day 2 and sustained through Week 12; generally well tolerated. Third positive Phase 3 readout overall (after Emerge in MDD and Voyage in GAD). Pre-NDA meeting planned 4Q 2026, NDA filing planned 1H 2027. DT120 holds FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation for both GAD and MDD.
Definium Therapeutics announces positive Phase 3 Panorama topline results for DT120 ODT in generalized anxiety disorder (HAM-A placebo-adjusted difference of 5.1 points); plans NDA filing 1H 2027
